title: Phase 2: Wire Error Tracking in Summarization Flow
description:
Connect error tracking to UnifiedAudioPlayer summarization flow.

Tasks:
- Call QueueCoordinator.markItemFailed() on summarization errors
- Call QueueCoordinator.resetItemForRetry() before retry attempts
- Track retryCount increments
- Skip to next item after max retries exceeded

Key files:
- UnifiedAudioPlayer.swift (summarization flow)
- QueueCoordinator.swift (error tracking methods)
